result.title: GaussianMamba: Geometric and Relational State Space Scanning of 3D Gaussian Primitives
result.summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction requires representing complex spatial structures and modeling contextual relationships across a scene. 3D Gaussian primitives provide a sparse and adaptive representation of scene geometry and semantics, while Mamba offers efficient sequence modeling for capturing dependencies among primitives. However, Gaussian primitives are irregular and unordered, making sequence construction challenging, as conventional spatial ordering may overlook their anisotropic geometry and feature-semantic relationships. In this paper, we present GaussianMamba, a dual-branch Mamba framework that explicitly incorporates Gaussian-specific geometric and feature-semantic relationships into complementary scanning strategies. The first branch refines a locality-preserving traversal using anisotropic Gaussian support derived from primitive scale and orientation. The second branch reorders spatially organized groups according to feature-semantic affinity and adjusts local features using geometry-weighted semantic differences. The resulting sequences are processed by separate Mamba modules, and their features are fused through a support-aware mechanism that incorporates local feature discrepancies arising from the distinct scanning paths. Experiments on nuScenes-SurroundOcc and SSCBench-KITTI-360 demonstrate consistent improvements over GaussianFormer and GaussianFormer-2 in both IoU and mIoU.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GaussianMamba 双分支框架，用各向异性高斯几何支持构造保局部性的遍历顺序，并按特征语义亲和重排分组，两路 Mamba 序列特征再经支持感知机制融合，用于 3D 语义占据预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按几何支持与特征语义亲和决定原语扫描顺序并做路径差异化融合的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据的排序、状态沿序列更新的路径设计及位置/相似度结构的影响有关，可供核查；但该工作情况属感知表征而非推理，迁移性尚不确定。
